verdict.rationale: Claude Code docs say its skills follow the Agent Skills open standard, which works across multiple AI tools (docs-47). Anthropic says it published Agent Skills as an open standard for cross-platform portability (docs-67, docs-75). The agentskills.io spec defines the same folder layout used in Anthropic's repo: a SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter plus name/description fields and optional scripts/references/assets directories (docs-26, docs-44, docs-51, docs-66, gh-3). One developer adapted skills from the anthropics/skills repo into a model-agnostic version run on Gemini (comm-17), which partly corroborates portability, though they had to build their own runtime. missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence that an unmodified skill folder runs in another vendor's agent, and clarity on whether Claude Code-specific frontmatter (invocation control) and plugin manifests stay valid under the spec.
